Smoking pipe. Made form copper alloy metal. The pipe-bowl and stem socket are joined forming a pointed angle. The pipe-bowl is cylindrical with a concave middle. It is decorated with incised linear bands and knobs. The stem socket is cylindrical with a ring attached to the underside. The pipe stem tapers towards the mouthpiece which has an ridged rim. There is a band of incised rings around the base of the stem. There is a ring attached to the underside of the pipe stem - there is a fabric cord tied to the rings on the stem socket and pipe stem. [AB [OPS Move] 27/9/2016]
